name: Pankaj Kumar Jha
summary:
Results-driven Enterprise Data & AI Architect with 14+ years of experience designing, governing, and securing cloud-native
data and AI platforms across GCP, Azure, and AWS, with deep expertise in enterprise data strategy, data governance, data
security, data virtualization, and modern operating models. Proven ability to integrate AI/ML, Agentic AI, and LLM-based
solutions (Vertex AI, LangChain) into enterprise ecosystems to enable intelligent automation, predictive analytics, and
trusted data products. Adept at leading the adoption of Data Mesh, Lakehouse, and federated analytics architectures, while
establishing DevOps, DataOps, and MLOps practices for CI/CD, automation, and platform resilience. A trusted advisor to
senior stakeholders, delivering scalable, compliant, and business-aligned architectures for global enterprises including BT,
HSBC, UPS, and Kimberly-Clark. PMP® certified with multi-cloud architect certifications, combining strategic leadership with
hands-on technical depth to drive measurable enterprise value.
